description: This file contains a Java class, LabelImage, which demonstrates how to use the TensorFlow Java API to load a pre-trained image classification model, process an input image, and output the label probabilities. It includes methods for reading files, constructing and executing a TensorFlow graph, and interpreting results.

classes.name: LabelImage
classes.description: Main class demonstrating image labeling with TensorFlow Java API.

classes.name: GraphBuilder
classes.description: Helper class to build parts of the TensorFlow graph programmatically.

methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the command-line application.

methods.description: Entry point of the application; loads model and image, runs inference, prints best label.

methods.description: Constructs a graph to preprocess an input image for the model and executes it.

methods.name: executeInceptionGraph
methods.description: Runs the image through the loaded TensorFlow graph to obtain label probabilities.
